Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntr: It's too much bother to think this out. I only wanted to battle!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefe: Even though I lost, I still like battling the best!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPost: Wouldn't you agree? You would go anywhere if TRAINERS were there.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntr: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush aside with one finger!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefe: I can push boulders, but I can't solve the puzzle…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPost: It's not good enough to be brawny… You have to use your head. Be brainy!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaInt: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier, isn't it?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPos: Has anyone made it to the end?
